claim: In the matching retail DLL, Player.ControlCheerSE (0x06004EBF) is a parameterless 225-byte method. It returns unless MatchMain.inst converts true and the current FormDispInfo flags contain raw bit mask 2. It then loads an integer level from Player.cheer_lv_tbl at animator.CurrentSkill.cheerLevel. If isCriticalMove is set it adds 2; otherwise if isSpecialMove is set it adds 1; otherwise, when the target Player exists, it adds (target wrestlerRank - host wrestlerRank) / 2 using integer arithmetic. It returns when the resulting level is zero or less, otherwise subtracts one and caps the result at 4. When Audience.inst is non-null it calls Audience.PlayLoopCheerVoice(level,false) followed by Audience.PlayCheerVoice(5,level), then returns. The already-closed FormAnimator.UpdateAnimation body calls this exact method at IL+0x02B0, and ControlCheerSE calls the already-closed GetCurrentFormDispInfo helper at IL+0x0018.
